title: Restaurant for Sale in Lusaka, Zambia
tagline: Zambian hospitality company operating 2 restaurant and dining branches in Lusaka, Zambia. - The business delivers contemporary dining and catering while combining modern presentation with authentic Zambian hospitality and cuisine. - Breakfast is a key offering, with the restaurants hosting breakfast meetings for private companies and large corporate clients, as well as attracting customers working remotely. - Grill platters designed for sharing are popular for family gatherings, birthday celebrations, corporate events, and year-end parties. - Women-focused events, including Valentine's Day, Women's Day, and Mother's Day programs, have been among the business's notable revenue-generating occasions. - The 2 branches contribute approximately 50% each to overall revenue, providing a balanced operating footprint. - Key compliance documents include a Certificate of Incorporation, Tax Clearance, and operating licenses covering council levy, health permits, liquor permits, and related requirements.
